Bihar Vidhan Parishad PA Score Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Vidhan Parishad (BVP), Government of Bihar, has released the score card for the post of PA. This recruitment was released for 64 posts. Applications for the Bihar Vidhan Parishad PA, DEO, LDC & Stenographer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 28 November 2025, to 05 January 2026. The examination was conducted on 10 May 2026. Candidates who had appeared in Pre Examination can download their Bihar Vidhan Parishad PA Score Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 November 2025
  • Last Date : 05 January 2026 (Extend)
  • Online Fee Payment Last Date : 07 January 2026
  • Exam Date : 05 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 30 March 2026
  • Phase-I Answer key : 09 April 2026
  • Phase-I Result : 28 April 2026
  • Phase-II Exam Date : 02 May 2026 (PA, Steno)
  • Phase-II Admit Card : 29 April 2026 (PA, Steno)
  • Exam Date : 10 May 2026 (DEO, LDC)
  • Admit Card : 06 May 2026 (DEO, LDC)
  • Pre Answer Key : 13 May 2026
  • LDC Pre Result : 12 August 2026
  • PA Final Result : 12 August 2026
  • Deo Pre Result : 13 August 2026
  • Stenographer Score Card : 13 August 2026
  • Final Result : 14 September 2026
  • PA Score Card : 19 September 2026

Application Fee

  • For All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
